question: Can unprinted fifth-or-finer decimal digits in each solar 盈縮加分 M, compatible with correctly truncated or nearest-rounded published four decimals, bridge the +20 microdegree summer post-table prose residual under independent daily microdegree quantization?

original_source_inputs.scope: Same Kyujanggak GK00893_00 original; all 183 ordinary 行度 and 181 numeric 日差 cells; displayed four-place recurrence.
Four direct original six-place prose totals on G893 018a/018b.
Original four-place M recurrence and all possible independent floor/ceil microdegree choices; this batch strengthens only the bounded hidden-tail exclusion.

assumptions: M4[d] = M4_initial - d*S4_initial - step4*d*(d-1)/2, d from 0 to ordinary terminal, integer units of 0.0001 numerical fen (not a historical definition of 少). This is a model derived from the previously observed printed short values; it is NOT a newly collated complete M-column.

For each day, an unprinted true numerical M[d] has the SAME four decimal digits M4[d] by either truncation toward zero of positive M or conventional nearest rounding. Therefore the union interval is [M4[d]-0.5, M4[d]+1) in integer M4 units. No broader upstream/model difference is allowed within this narrow test.

Convert the positive M magnitude to microdegrees by q[d]=floor(M[d]/100) or ceil(M[d]/100), independently chosen per day. Winter daily degree is 1,000,000+q[d], summer 1,000,000-q[d]. This includes ordinary daily floor/ceil and nearest choices, but NOT a distinct high-precision aggregate or operation before M quantization.
For skip-initial prose control replace only the day-zero signed correction by zero, as in 13SK/13SN. Neither the original sense of 休 nor the ancient internal algorithm is thereby settled.

integer_proof.scale: 100 four-place fen units equal one microdegree of correction; the fractional remainder is M4[d] % 100
integer_proof.interval: For either allowed print policy, M[d] lies in [M4[d]-0.5, M4[d]+1). For every one of 183 reconstructed daily M4 values, remainder modulo 100 is strictly between 0 and 100. Consequently floor(M[d]/100)=floor(M4[d]/100) and ceil(M[d]/100)=ceil(M4[d]/100) over the entire interval; no per-day integer microdegree quantizer can change.
integer_proof.replay_pseudocode: for d in range(N): m=M0-d*S0-step*d*(d-1)//2; r=m%100; assert 0<r<100; qlo=m//100; qhi=(m+99)//100; full_min/full_max=sum(1000000+sign*q); skip_initial=sum(...) with d0 correction replaced by 0

adjudication.excluded: Adding only sub-fourth-place hidden tails consistent with four-place truncation or nearest rounding to every daily M cannot change even a single daily floor/ceil microdegree option, so the previous 13SN summer upper bounds remain absolute within this model. Both summer originals exceed them by 20 microdegrees.
adjudication.not_excluded: Hidden upstream differences large enough to alter the four-place M itself, nonlocal carry before each M is printed, sub-daily/nonlinear arithmetic, independent high-precision aggregate, transmitted prose numeral variants, or an original period-specific definition of 少/微.

next: Seek independent authentic original same-field unit/carry or a source of the six-place post-table aggregates, rather than assuming omitted fifth/sixth digits in otherwise identical four-place daily M. Preserve TW-OPEN-0005 P0 OPEN and six historic original-target winners 0/6.
